services.name: Book a Cruise
services.desc: There is one hour in Washington, DC when the whole city seems to hold still - when the marble goes gold, the water turns to glass, and the noise of the capital fades to a hum. We built Cruise The Potomac around that hour. Every sunset cruise here is private. No shared decks, no fixed script, no crowd of strangers angling for the same photo. Just your party, your captain, and Geronimo carrying you past the monuments as the light changes. Washington is a city built to be seen from the water, and never more so than at golden hour.
